mechanism: Nafcillin may reduce zoledronic acid efficacy through enzyme induction and potential effects on bisphosphonate absorption/metabolism, while zoledronic acid may increase risk of nephrotoxicity in patients with renal impairment.
action: Monitor renal function closely, ensure adequate hydration, and verify that zoledronic acid dosing is appropriate for current renal status; consider alternative antibiotics with fewer metabolic interactions if possible.
